turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good afternoon, Claire. Adrian Lim speaking. Thank you for calling. Are you somewhere comfortable to talk, or would you like a moment to settle down before we start?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Hello, Adrian. I'm at home, so it's quite quiet. I've brought my notebook over to the table. Just let me put my glasses on.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Of course, no hurry. May I have your identification details for our check, please?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: My FIN is F seven nine nine seven nine one seven Y. My date of birth is 24 July 1962.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you, Claire. We can take things at a comfortable pace today. I recommend buying Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Okay, noted. These telephone appointments are convenient. I can keep my papers spread out instead of carrying everything into town. I've just come in from tending to my plants, actually.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: That's a pleasant way to spend the afternoon. Have you been gardening for a while, or is it something you've started recently?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Quite recently, lah. Mostly herbs on the balcony, nothing too ambitious. My neighbour gave me some cuttings, and now I find myself checking on them every morning.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Nice to have a little routine like that. Let me turn to the items for today's discussion. So your objective remains long-term growth through a diversified investment, with a balance between growth potential and stability. For Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund, the equity holdings can pull the fund's value down when stock markets fall, while its fixed-income holdings can decline when interest rates rise. Do you understand how stock-market declines and rising interest rates can affect the fund's value?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I understand that falling stock markets can affect the equity holdings, and rising interest rates can reduce the value of the fixed-income holdings.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: The transaction fee is 0.5% of the subscription amount. Can you confirm whether you are willing to accept investment losses within your planned allocation?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I am willing to accept investment losses and fluctuations, provided this stays within my planned allocation. I'll just turn to the relevant page in my notebook now. I put a tab in it, but it seems to have slipped.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Take your time. I'm here, and there's no need to rush through your papers.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Here we are. The fund I want to transact in is Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund. Please use euros as the transaction currency. Looking at my allocation notes, the amount I want to subscribe is 1,000,000.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I'll give you a moment with the page. Let me know when you're ready to continue.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Sorry, I read the overall budget rather than the subscription entry. Change the subscription amount to 75,000. My handwriting is rather cramped in this part of the notebook.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: No problem, Claire. I'll stay on the line while you finish looking through it.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Actually, that entry was provisional; I've now found my completed allocation decision. The final subscription amount is 150,000, replacing what I just said. The quantity for this transaction is 2,000 units. I want to buy those units. Please place a limit order with a limit price of 75 euros per unit.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: With your corrections applied, your final instruction is to buy 2,000 units of Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund for 150,000 euros, using a limit order at a limit price of 75 euros per unit. Do you confirm this instruction?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I confirm that final instruction with the corrected amount. Please proceed.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you, Claire. That brings us to the end of today's call. I've also noted your preference for speaking by telephone when we arrange appointments.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thanks, Adrian. That suits me much better. I'll put my notebook away now and get back to my afternoon.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: You're welcome. Enjoy the rest of your day, and goodbye.
